title: Blower motor fault
shortDescription: Blower not running at commanded speed.
fullDescription: Thermador range hoods report E1 when the blower motor's tachometer feedback is missing. Cause is usually grease-bound impeller, failed capacitor, or motor end-of-life.

title: Heat sentry triggered
fullDescription: E2 indicates the heat sentry sensor triggered the auto-on protection. Hood will run high until the cooktop cools.
videoSearchQuery: Thermador range hood E2 heat sentry

faq.a: Cannot - it is a safety feature.

title: Filter cleaning reminder
fullDescription: E3 indicates accumulated runtime triggered the filter reminder. Wash filters and reset.
videoSearchQuery: Thermador range hood E3 filter reset

title: Light circuit overcurrent
fullDescription: E4 indicates the LED or halogen driver tripped on overcurrent. Replace lamp and check harness.

title: Auto-damper fault
fullDescription: E5 indicates the motorized damper actuator did not open. Clean the flap or replace the actuator.

title: Touch panel stuck
fullDescription: E6 indicates a touch button reads pressed >30 seconds. Wipe dry and reset.

title: Remote sensor lost
fullDescription: E7 indicates the wireless heat sensor lost contact with the hood. Replace battery or re-pair.

title: Low input voltage
fullDescription: E8 alerts that input voltage fell below operating spec. Check breaker and any in-line GFCI.

fixSteps.title: Reset GFCI
fixSteps.instruction: Press reset button on GFCI receptacle.

title: Control board fault
fullDescription: E9 means the main hood control failed self-test. Replace the board.

title: Sensor calibration
fullDescription: E0 displays briefly while sensors calibrate. It clears within 30 seconds.
